notes.title: WestHalla is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
For fans of rougelikes, strategy RPGs, and cowboys, WestHalla aims to deliver an experience for players to live out their old west fantasies.

After nearly a year of development and planning, WestHalla is set to release at the end of July, 2023. WestHalla offers a replayable experience with rich strategical depth. Wishlist today!
